item.title: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her lifelong defense of human rights and international law.

item.title: ICE shooting in NYC fuels tension between New York officials and Trump administration
item.description: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement shot a man in New York City. It raised tensions between the Trump administration and New York officials over the state's sanctuary policies.

item.title: Major Hurricane Isaias takes aim on Gulf Coast
item.description: Hurricane Isaias in poised to make landfall on the Gulf Coast near the Alabama-Florida boarder. It will be the first hurricane to make landfall in the U.S. since 2024.

item.title: How the beverage aisle got so wild
item.description: Planet Money traced many new beverage flavors to one laboratory that serves dozens of companies to see how new flavors are created and why we're seeing such an explosion of options right now.

item.title: Mike Ditka, the legendary coach who led the Bears to a Superbowl, dies at 86
item.description: Hall of Fame football player and legendary coach Mike Ditka led the Chicago Bears to the team's only Superbowl win in 1986. He died Friday at 86.
